annotations.title: Read the declared kinds and rules

description: Read what the FOLIO.md declarations applying at a path declare: the kinds of documents with the fields each carries, the rules - queries whose every row is a violation - and the health entries, layered from the served folder down as Folio applies them. Use it before writing a document of a kind, to learn its fields and the rules it must keep; for one document's own kind and field values use folio_document, and for the rules broken now folio_health. Answers {declarations: [FOLIO.md paths, outermost first], kinds: [{name, declaredIn, where, fields}], rules: [{name, declaredIn, query, message, severity, line and block: where it is declared}], health: [{declaredIn, where, skip, error}]}, every list empty where nothing is declared. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: A document, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/plan.md, or a folder ending in /, such as notes/; omit for the served folder itself
